card.name: Last digit of years in citations
card.fires_on: The final digit of a four-digit year split into pieces, such as 197<<8>> or 199<<9>>, in reference lists and in-text citations. It fires on the last digit of the year after the century and decade digits.

modes.label: Year in reference entry
modes.description: Last digit of a publication year after the author name in a bibliography.
modes.example: - de Zwaan, Jan Daniel (196<<9>>). "Two studies in Gogo-Y

modes.label: Year in in-text citation
modes.description: Last digit of a year inside parentheses with an agency or author name.

card.writes: It promotes single lowercase letters, which fits the a, b, c suffix that follows a year in citations, and it suppresses capitalized letters.
card.plain: It marks the last digit of a year in a citation, where a letter like a or b may come next.
